FINAL CHECKS · ITEM 05 / 05

Private gains versus social welfare私人收益與社會福利

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

For a before-and-after question, distinguish a participant's gain or loss from the change in total surplus and from government revenue or expenditure.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

分別算 CS、PS 及政府收入或支出，再加總。某方得益不等於社會總收益增加；轉移付款可只改變分配。

Separate changes in CS, PS and government revenue or spending before adding total surplus. A participant gaining money does not establish a social gain; transfers can change distribution without increasing total value.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：After a subsidy CS rises 30, PS rises 20, government spends 60. Total surplus changes by 30+20−60=−10. 私人均得益但總剩餘減十。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

CS rises 10,PS rises 15,government spends 40. Change in total surplus? 總剩餘變化？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
